title: Empiremodpack 2.0
description: Vanilla+ exploration RPG modpack with heavy worldgen, strong farming/cooking systems, deep decoration, and large dungeon progression content.
body:
A Vanilla+ exploration and RPG-style modpack built for immersive survival gameplay. Discover expanded biomes, improved terrain generation, and massive new structures and dungeons across the world and multiple dimensions. Encounter unique creatures, enhanced wildlife, and challenging enemies while progressing through exploration-based gameplay.

Expand your survival experience with deeper farming, cooking, and utility systems, alongside a large selection of building and decoration mods for highly detailed bases. Performance, visual, and audio enhancements ensure a smooth and atmospheric experience.

Balanced for both singleplayer and multiplayer, this modpack focuses on exploration, progression, and creativity without straying too far from the vanilla feel.
